reason: The text demonstrates through multiple deliberate actions that Yahweh actively intervenes to ensure the Israelites' safety and wellbeing. Specifically: (1) Yahweh tells Moses 'Yahweh will fight for you' (יְהוָה יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם); (2) Yahweh commands the sea to be split, enabling the Israelites to escape through on dry ground; (3) Yahweh saves Israel from the hand of the Egyptians (וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל); and (4) Yahweh defeats the pursuing Egyptian army by returning the waters upon them. These protective, life-saving interventions demonstrate a clear concern for the Israelites' welfare and survival.
